body:
closes https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/issues/350 - This PR adds a function for computing the residual for any iteration, reconstruct the residual as a `OutputVar` if you are using the ClimaAnalysis extension, and plotting the residual.

This function also fix a bug with the units of reconstructing the diagonal of a covariance matrix.

title: Add utilities for residual
